VERSION — a single line holding macacfs's semantic version; its patch number increments on every commit. bin/macacfs reads it into MACACFS_VERSION for 'macacfs version' and the usage banner, so it [[argv-code|serves|The version subcommand and usage banner print the value read from this file.]]. Bead (data).
